decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The source page changed (new revision) and now frames cloud and local sandboxing together. It does not state a release stage, so lifecycle stays unverified. Billing is usage-based; local sandboxing is included in the seat.

citations.quote: Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub.
Billing applies to cloud sandboxing only. Local sandboxing is included in the standard GitHub Copilot seat at no additional cost.
